purpose: Test rotation-view training with a matched continued-training control; settings fixed before fitting/evaluation
variants: same continuation plus rotation-only auxiliary loss

augmentation.virtual_view_rotations: symmetric minus/plus half of the relative camera rotation
augmentation.pixel_sampling: same bilinear reprojection for both views, then shared runtime grayscale/area resize
augmentation.invalid_policy: reject/resample any pair with out-of-source samples; no angle-dependent black borders or confidence inputs
augmentation.camera_motion: fixed optical centre and constant angular velocity over 0.05 seconds
augmentation.imu: ten 200 Hz samples with source-episode extrinsics, world gravity, noise, bias and random-walk priors; centripetal lever-arm acceleration supported
augmentation.labels: exact SO(3) relative rotation; auxiliary translation is not supervised
augmentation.scene_split: retain original train2/3/4 versus validation5/6; public scene1 excluded

training.real_objective: original normalized Smooth L1 pose loss plus 2.0 photometric warping loss
training.auxiliary_objective: 0.1 times Smooth L1 of SO(3) geodesic angle divided by norm of original rotation target_std
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest equal-episode accumulated rotation RMSE on REAL validation, subject to both translation guards; include epoch0, keep earlier on ties

visual_probe.type: whole image-pair permutation, fixed states and labels
visual_probe.interpretation: out-of-distribution sensitivity diagnostic, not standalone proof of useful visual inference

deployment: unchanged MotionNet architecture, inference code, resolution and enabled rotation residual; map off
timing: serial full public runs after training and probes stop
